current_example.problem:
$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}^{′}(t)=9x(t)+6y(t) \\ {y}^{′}(t)=-6x(t)-6y(t)\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the system of linear differential equations above. The eigenvalues of the system's matrix are $\lambda_1=6$ and $\lambda_2=-3,$ for which the corresponding eigenvectors are $\mathbf{v}_1 = [-2, \ 1]^T$ and $\mathbf{v}_2 = [-1, \ 2]^T,$ respectively. Complete the following statements about the system by filling in the blanks.

Identify stable and unstable lines, and classify the equilibrium point (origin).
current_example.worked_solution:
The general solution of the system is
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14122747/assets/edee348ae37ffdb64676b201c7c8bb6193d48967ab23c4f30ca3c7c9d88b74f9.svg)

- The line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14122747/assets/c592293242d8929f3e15929aa97dbbfb5df90bca32f1cec2bb112ac148b4b6e9.svg) has the equation 

$$
y= -\dfrac12x.
$$

The straight-line solutions of the form
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14122747/assets/bd8a143ed6abf07d57908cd1a32495a9c1a4db437bfce4b292639f479f976b38.svg)
lie on that line and approach infinity as $t \to \infty.$ So, $y=-\dfrac12x$ is an unstable line.

- The line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14122747/assets/bdc8baa79c34eee3fd21729a666ff06befa4ded61d7109d4fdcf2aaf84430fd8.svg) has the equation 

$$
y=-2x.
$$

The straight-line solutions of the form
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14122747/assets/07b7577ab5b3a297263c0223fcdc3db2c28847c122d7a36f05af49237d33fc19.svg)
lie on that line and approach the origin as $t \to \infty.$ So, $y=-2x$ is a stable line.

Therefore, the equilibrium point (origin) is a saddle point. 

**Note:** The phase portrait of the system looks as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14122747/assets/2710e11309547500aa3e9ba89f31281cbbc28244509046ed25a6c151c10c23ed.png)
